limitations: One six-round run; net six-task gap; paired exact p≈0.263 does not establish stable superiority.
Token expenditure differs by about 3.7x, despite six rounds and same optimizer route.
AHE first-round debugger deployment failed; repaired for rounds 2–6.
Methods use different solver runners (native shared Life vs genuine NexAU AHE); this is not an evolve-only controlled ablation.
TEST examples are post-hoc explanations, not training evidence for a future optimizer.

Allow bounded offline candidate-versus-incumbent probes with real host hook plumbing, stubbed solver/environment and positive/negative controls.
